candidates.name: ring
candidates.rationale: Vetted cryptographic library used by major Rust projects; provides SHA-1 via digest::SHA1_FOR_LEGACY_USE_ONLY.
risks: SHA-1 is deprecated for collision resistance; suitable only for legacy wire-protocol compatibility

candidates.name: sha1
candidates.rationale: Pure-Rust SHA-1 implementation; smaller dependency footprint than ring.

candidates.name: std::collections::HashMap
candidates.rationale: Standard-library hash map; equivalent semantics for the redis dict use cases.

candidates.name: hashbrown
candidates.rationale: The hash map implementation that backs std::collections::HashMap since Rust 1.36; useful when the no_std crate ecosystem is needed.

transformation_hints.source_pattern: function returning int error code (-1 on failure, 0 on success)
transformation_hints.transformation: Map the C error code return to a Rust Result. Use the `?` operator at the call site instead of explicit `if (rc == -1) goto cleanup;` blocks.
